title: GIMUN 26 and GMC VII registrations are open
body: Registrations for GIMUN 26 and GMC VII, held from 4 to 6 December 2026 at GIK Institute, Topi, are open on the official forms. See the Register page for the forms, the fee tiers and the payment details.

title: GMC VII memorials due 15 November
body: Memorials for both sides are due by 15 November 2026. The memorial submission link is sent to each team after it registers. Bring three hard copies of each memorial when you arrive.

title: Liaison packages published
body: The GIMUN 26 and GMC VII liaison packages, with the fee structure, rules, instructions and contacts, are in the resource library.
